description: Compare ranking pages to find shared page keywords or competitor-page keywords excluded from your pages. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

exclude_pages.description: Absolute page URLs to exclude from the keyword intersection comparison. Type: Array. Maximum: 5 items. Default: [].

items.description: One absolute page URL to exclude from the keyword intersection. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

ignore_synonyms.description: Ask the provider not to expand keyword matching to synonyms when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_clickstream_data.description: Request available provider clickstream-derived estimates when true; these are not your own analytics measurements. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

include_serp_info.description: Include provider search-result context in the returned records when true. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

include_subdomains.description: Include links or ranking data for subdomains of the target when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

intersection_mode.description: Whether matches must cover every supplied target (all) or a supported subset (partial). Type: String. Accepted values: "union", "intersect". Default: "union".

item_types.description: Search-result categories to include in the page intersection analysis. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 4 items. Default: ["organic","featured_snippet"].

items.description: One search-result category to include in the comparison. Type: String. Accepted values: "organic", "paid", "featured_snippet", "local_pack". Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of keyword intersection records to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 5. Maximum: 100. Default: 25.

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

location_code.description: Numeric provider location identifier for the search market; the service validates support alongside the location name. Type: Safe integer. Must be greater than 0. Optional; no client default.

max_rank.description: Worst organic search position to include, where 1 means first. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 30.

min_search_volume.description: Minimum estimated monthly keyword searches to include; zero disables this lower-bound filter. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000000. Default: 0.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset measured in rows; use with limit for pagination. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 20000. Default: 0.

pages.description: Absolute page URLs whose ranking keywords should be compared; these are URLs, not supplied page objects. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 5 items. Required.

items.description: One absolute page URL whose ranking keywords should be compared. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "opportunity", "search_volume", "traffic_gap", "rank", "cpc". Default: "opportunity".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

name: agentseo_page_intersection
title: AgentSEO Page Intersection
